# GitHub Integration

Manages the GitHub API version used by the app.

## Overview

This layer handles the integration with the GitHub API, ensuring that the app uses a specific version of the API to avoid deprecation issues.

## Responsibilities

- Manages the GitHub API version.
- Ensures that all requests to the GitHub API include the correct version header.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`app/src/github.ts`](../app/src/github.ts) | Manages the GitHub API version used by the app. | `GITHUB_API_VERSION`, `withApiVersion` |

## How it works

The `app/src/github.ts` file defines the `GITHUB_API_VERSION` constant and a function `withApiVersion` that adds the version header to GitHub API requests.
